q30.
memos.memo.created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:14`)
memos.memo.updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:19`)
memos.memo.deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:24`)
memos.memo.comment.created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:29`)

Delivery: all dispatch paths converge at `webhook.PostAsync` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:43,71`), which queues payloads for workers that invoke `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-53`); `Post` performs the outbound HTTP POST via `safeClient.Do` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:119-152`).
